portrait.label: Tall cards
portrait.note: Each photograph a tall card with rounded corners, the name and place under it. Closest to how a person is photographed, so faces are cropped least. The default.

round.label: Circles
round.note: Each face in a circle, the name and place centred under it. Lighter, and a little smaller, so more faces show at once.

ground.label: Background
ground.note: The colour behind this section. Change it between one section and the next so the page reads as bands instead of one flat colour.

plain.label: Default
plain.note: The page's own background colour. Quiet, and the right choice for most sections.

soft.label: Light
soft.note: A soft tint. The easiest way to separate one section from the one above it.

brand.label: Brand colour
brand.note: Your brand colour, with text chosen to stay readable on it. Best used once or twice a page, not on everything.

deep.label: Dark
deep.note: A dark band. The boldest option, and the one that loses its impact if you use it more than once.

motion.label: Movement
motion.note: Whether this section moves by itself. Nothing moves for a visitor who has asked their device for less motion, whichever you pick.

default.label: Still
default.note: Nothing moves. The visitor swipes the row, or steps along it with the round arrows that show when there are more faces than fit. The default.

moving.label: Moves
moving.note: The row glides along by itself, with a round button to stop it, and halts while the visitor points at it, uses the keyboard in it or drags it. A row whose faces all fit stays still. It needs the platform's behaviour library; where that is not served the row is simply still.
